sources.title: smdesai/Nemotron-3.5-Parse-CoreAI · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3.5 Parse for Core AI nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse, a 0.63B document parser (text, layout classes and boxes, tables as LaTeX, charts), converted to Apple Core AI to run on an iPhone or a Mac. This is the phone build: fp16 compute, the vision encoder in fp16 and the decoder's weights in int8, with speculative decoding through the checkpoint's multi-token-prediction head.

sources.snippet: The Nemotron-3.5-Embed-1B-BF16 is suitable for users who want to build a multimodal question-and-answer application over a large corpus, leveraging the latest dense retrieval technology. The input of the model is a text or a document image, and the output is a fixed-size embedding vector. sources.title: Nemotron AI Models | NVIDIA Developer
sources.snippet: Nemotron Pre- and Post-Training Datasets NVIDIA provides more than 12T tokens of multilingual reasoning, coding, and safety data, plus the post-training datasets that ship with Nemotron models, to help the community build their custom models. Released with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL: a synthetic Indic pretraining corpus of about 2.83T tokens in 22 languages, co-created with IIT Madras.
